items.title: Can Intercontinental Exchange (ICE) Justify Its Price Through Excess Returns?
items.summary: Intercontinental Exchange has turned in a solid run over the past few years, and fresh moves into areas like perpetual futures and tokenized markets keep the story in motion. That raises a simple but important question for you as a shareholder or potential buyer: whether the current price is adequately backed by the returns the group earns on the capital it puts to work. Over the past 3 years the stock has returned 62.9%, which puts real weight on whether that climb is matched by the returns...
